settingsHub.title: Settings
settingsHub.subtitle: Tell AI Radar who you are, where to pull news from, and whether to attach an LLM.
settingsHub.contextDesc: Role, projects, tech. Relevance is about you, not a global leaderboard.
settingsHub.sourcesDesc: RSS, Hacker News, GitHub, Reddit, V2EX, Zhihu and more — toggle any time.
settingsHub.llmNotReady: Not configured — rule scoring only (fully usable)
settingsHub.aiOn: AI is on: impact, summaries and recommendations come from the LLM; items are tagged AI.
settingsHub.aiOff: AI is not configured: all scores are rule-based (keyword hits + source weight + heat) and tagged rule. Add an OpenAI-compatible endpoint under AI model to enable.
settingsHub.howItWorksBody: Each item's score stacks two layers: (1) rules — interest-keyword hits, source weight (GitHub/HN boosted), and heat (log stars/points); (2) AI — once an LLM is configured, impact analysis runs on changes. Rule scores are always explainable; the bonus reasons are listed under each item. Without an LLM, the system only ranks and clusters — it will not fabricate templated 'why this matters to you' copy.
